text:
samir: Heads-up — starting to onboard gpt-small-merge. Weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/gpt-small-merge/v1/ (sharded, fp16 + int8 profiles). Need validation for runtime readiness: tokenizer mismatches, kernel selection, and whether our current CUDA/Triton image will handle the fused-attn kernels for int8.

jess: Thanks. Quick Q — is this the repo with the tokenizer artifacts? Link?

samir: Yep: s3 path has tokenizer.json, merges.txt, special_tokens_map.json. Noticed different normalizer in tokenizer.json vs our standard HF tokenizer.

olive: I skimmed tokenizer.json — it's using old NFKC normalizer and a custom unk token <|unk_src|>. Our tokenizer loader currently expects unk token called <|unk|>.

olive: Fix is small, add mapping during load:

```python
# in tokenizer loader
if config.get('special_tokens_map', {}).get('unk') == '<|unk_src|>':
    tokenizer.add_special_tokens({'unk_token': '<|unk|>'})
```

jess: Good catch. Also note merges.txt uses a slightly different joiner token — we should validate merges parity before serving. I can add a quick unit test.

ron: On the runtime side: current infra image uses CUDA 12.1 + Triton 2.16. There are known issues with Triton 2.16 and the new fused_attn_v2 kernels on our TF32-optimized path. If we fall back, perf drops ~30%. Build logs from canary show kernel compile errors for int8 kernels.

buildbot: CI: build/runtime-image:latest -> build failed: triton compile error at aten_fused_attn_int8.cu: unresolved symbol 'cutlass::...'

ciara: I can rebuild images with Triton 2.18 + CUDA 12.3 base, and enable the newer cutlass path. Will need to bump gcc and rebuild libcutlass. ETA ~2 hours.

samir: Is there a temporary workaround to get this model into a canary pool without full image rebuild?

ron: Two options: 1) run model on CPU-only fallback (terrible perf), or 2) serve on nodes with older kernel selection that forces non-fused kernels but keeps GPU path — slower but acceptable for a brief canary. We have a node pool 'gpu-compat-legacy' with prebuilt kernels. I can route one canary there.

jess: For config validation, can we run the model through the config-check script? ron, does the script also validate kv-cache and max-seq config for fused kernels?

ron: yes: `tools/check_model_config.py --model s3://redwood-models/gpt-small-merge/v1/` checks tokenizer, kv-cache attrs, layernorm eps, dtype hints, and kernel hints. It will fail if it detects incompatible attention configs.

samir: Ran it locally; output attached -> shows attention algo hint "fused_attn_v2" and quantization profile int8-azq which triggers Triton compile path.

olive: For tokenizer, I'll add a quick compatibility shim in model manifest to remap unk/joiner. Want to avoid making model code changes. I'll push patch to manifest and open PR.

ciara: Re: image rebuild — I'll kick off the container build in a separate pipeline and tag `runtime:cuda12.3-triton2.18-cutlassv2`. Will report back when pushed to staging.

buildbot: Pipeline started: container-build-20240627-1145 -> log: pulling base image nvcr.io/nvidia/cuda:12.3-devel, building cutlass, compiling triton.

samir: For canary routing: once image is ready, I'd like a small canary (5 qps, concurrency 2) with auto-fallback to gpt-small-merge-v1-cpu if latency > 250ms. Is that config in the rollout YAML or console?

ron: Both — prefer YAML for reproducibility. Example snippet: 

```yaml
rollout:
  strategy: canary
  canary:
    qps: 5
    concurrency: 2
    fallback: gpt-small-merge-v1-cpu
    health_check: latency < 250ms for 1m
```

jess: I'll add a unit test for tokenizer parity and a CI job that runs `check_model_config.py` on every onboarding PR.

ciara: Image build complete and pushed to staging: runtime:cuda12.3-triton2.18-cutlassv2. Please smoke test.

buildbot: smoketest -> ok: triton kernels compiled, int8 fused_attn benchmarks ~1.1x perf vs older image.

ron: Rolling canary to gpu-compat-legacy pool now. Samir, update manifest to point to the new image tag.

samir: Done. Manifest updated and PR linked. Rolling policy set as above.

olive: PR merged for tokenizer shim. jess's tests added.

jess: :thumbsup: I'll watch the canary metrics. If we see model quality regressions due to quantization, open evals alert.

samir: Great — thanks everyone. If canary looks good after 30m, we'll promote to dedicated pool. 

ciara: ETA for promotion path readiness ~30-45m after stable smoke tests.

buildbot: Note: monitoring alert channel #incidents will get automated anomaly notifications.

ron: FYI, follow-up: we'll schedule a postmortem doc for the kernel selection edge-case and update our onboarding checklist to include the triton+cutlass compat table.

samir: Sounds good. Closing the loop here. 

olive: :eyes:

jess: watching now.
